gbpPost.content:
South Tulsa pergola and fireplace patio, built for the long Oklahoma shoulder seasons — cool October nights included. We just wrapped an investment-grade build in Midtown Tulsa: a Techo-Bloc Travertina Raw patio set over a compacted, freeze-thaw-ready base, anchored by a cedar-tone aluminum pergola and a stacked-stone gas fireplace. A Blaze built-in grill and Volt copper landscape lighting turn the whole run into an outdoor room that works from morning coffee to midnight. The detail we obsess over: every paver joint polymer-locked and swept twice, so weeds and washout never get a foothold.

This is our 9th South Tulsa build this year — built right the first time, Oklahoma-tough from the base up.
